paper_title: PaLM: Scaling Language Modeling with Pathways

claims.statement: The authors trained a 540-billion parameter, densely activated, Transformer language model named PaLM using 6144 TPU v4 chips via the Pathways system.

evidence.quote: we trained a 540-billion parameter, densely activated, Transformer language model, which we call Pathways Language Model (PaLM). We trained PaLM on 6144 TPU v4 chips using Pathways
